lead.title: OpenAI announces Jalapeño inference chip, claims major efficiency gains
lead.summary: OpenAI shared first measured results for Jalapeño, its custom inference silicon, at Hot Chips 2026. The chip delivers significant gains in efficiency, throughput, and lower latency — more intelligence per watt — without trade-offs. Initial deployment in OpenAI's own compute infrastructure begins by end of 2026 as Gen 1 of a multi-generation roadmap.

top_stories.title: AMD MI400 Helios rack architecture delivers 2.9 exaflops at Hot Chips 2026
top_stories.summary: AMD detailed the Instinct MI455X silicon with 40.26 peak petaflops (MXFP4), up to 4x the MI355X. Helios racks offer 2.9 exaflops, 31 TB of HBM4 memory, and 1.7 PB/s bandwidth across 72 GPUs paired with EPYC Venice CPUs.

top_stories.title: Generalist reaches $3B valuation with $200M extension led by 8VC
top_stories.summary: The AI robotics foundation model startup raised a $200M Series B extension from 8VC, Radical Ventures, Nvidia, USV, and Bezos Expeditions. Total round now stands at $600M at a $3B valuation.

top_stories.title: Self-driving truck startup Gatik raises $200M Series D led by Qatar Investment Authority
top_stories.summary: Autonomous middle-mile freight company Gatik closed a $200M Series D, backed by Koch Disruptive Technologies, Millennium Management, ARK Invest, and Intact Private Capital. The startup has $600M in contracted revenue and 85,000 driverless orders on the books.

top_stories.title: Chinese humanoid robot sets 100-meter sprint record of 8.86 seconds at Beijing World Games
top_stories.summary: The Tiangong Ultra humanoid ran 100 meters in 8.86 seconds at the World Humanoid Robot Games, beating both robot competitors and Usain Bolt's 9.58-second human world record. The second edition features over 2,000 robots across 51 events.

items.title: On-policy self-distillation aligns diffusion models with human preferences
items.summary: DiffusionOPSD converts image-level rewards into fine-grained denoising supervision, bridging RL alignment with on-policy distillation for text-to-image models.

items.title: Meta$^n$: Recursive self-improvement through emergent depth in LLMs
items.summary: Self-improving agents typically cap out at two meta-levels. This paper proposes a mechanism that lets systems recursively edit their own editing machinery, unlocking deeper emergent reasoning.

items.title: WeMM-Embedding: WeChat's universal multimodal embedding family
items.summary: A family of universal multimodal embeddings from Tencent, enabling heterogeneous content to share a representation space for retrieval, recommendation, classification, and agentic systems.

items.title: NeuronGuard redistributes safety signals in LLMs against jailbreaks and pruning attacks
items.summary: Both crafted jailbreak prompts and post-deployment neuron pruning exploit a common weakness: safety-relevant activations are concentrated in easily removed components. NeuronGuard redistributes them robustly.

items.title: Contrastive Branch Policy Optimization improves sparse reward learning for tool agents
items.summary: Branch sampling introduces local comparisons among intermediate decisions, addressing the sparse-outcome problem in multi-turn tool-calling RL for language models.

items.title: Qwen3.8-27B now available on Together AI for fine-tuning and dedicated inference
items.summary: Alibaba's latest 27B MoE open-weights model is live on Together AI with a unified stack for both fine-tuning and dedicated model inference.

items.title: Together AI ranks top open models by use case — Kimi K3 leads chat and coding
items.summary: Kimi K3 leads in chat, reasoning, and coding agents; Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B dominates vision; DeepSeek V4 Flash leads mid-size general purpose and function calling.

items.title: Nous Research adds 44 new MCP connectors for Hermes Agent desktop app
items.summary: One-click setup for tool integrations across common applications, expanding Hermes Agent's skill ecosystem.

items.title: NVIDIA BlueField-4 DPU detailed at Hot Chips 2026 as key to Vera Rubin AI factory
items.summary: The fourth-generation data processing unit ties CPU, GPU, and network together, handling networking, security, and storage in every data center node as the trusted entity isolating host from fabric.

items.title: Intel dives deep on Crescent Island AI accelerator at Hot Chips 2026
items.summary: Built on Xe3P architecture with larger caches and deeper XMX engines, Crescent Island uses liquid-cooled chips and HBM4 memory targeting maximum AI flops-per-watt for agentic inference at scale.

items.title: World humanoid robot games show runners breaking records, bursting into flames
items.summary: Ars Technica reports from Beijing where humanoid robots broke sprint records but also crashed into barriers and caught fire, underscoring that robots remain engineered for single tasks rather than general-purpose autonomy.

items.title: Xiaomi AI Cube uses three XRING chips and LPDDR6 memory for local 120B parameter models
items.summary: Engineering prototype built around three internally developed XRING processors (O3, O100, D100) capable of running local models up to 120B parameters with a 16-core G2 Ultra NX GPU at 150W sustained.

items.title: akta.pro — Private company data API for the agent economy
items.summary: Launched on Product Hunt (score 347). Delivers 4x depth and 2x coverage of PitchBook with 100+ event signals for agents to source deals and trigger outbound.

items.title: Diet Claude — Chrome extension for Claude usage limit management
items.summary: Shows real-time Claude usage meter and resets, optimizes tokens via context trimming, and carries conversations to another LLM when limits hit. 320 upvotes.

items.title: Agnost AI detects silent failures in production AI agents
items.summary: Analyzes user-agent conversations to find behavior drift, hallucinations, user frustration, and churn signals. Groups patterns and surfaces exact conversations behind each insight.

items.title: Agentcard — A debit card designed for AI agents
items.summary: Provides a debit card that AI agents (OpenClaw, Claude) can use to make online purchases safely with one API call. Solves the payment-infrastructure gap for autonomous agents.
